plates.side_label: 1882 FLEMMING MITOSIS (2N = 46) VS 1903 SUTTON MEIOSIS (2N → N = 23) & 1905 NETTIE STEVENS XX/XY SEX CHROMOSOMES

plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Walther Flemming (1882 Zellsubstanz, Kern und Zelltheilung) salamander mitosis phases (prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase keeping 2n = 46 constant) vs Walter Sutton (1903 Biol. teach_overlay.scale: mitosis is like photocopying a forty-six-volume encyclopaedia so two libraries get the exact same set — while meiosis shuffles your mother's twenty-three volumes with your father's twenty-three volumes to print a brand-new twenty-three-volume edition for every egg or sperm
